solution: Lowered the payment client timeout from 10 seconds to 3 seconds and sent failed payments to the retry topic so the main loop kept moving.
short_description: Orders queue consumer lag from slow payment gateway
trigger: payment-gateway p95 latency rose from 300 ms to 4 s
problem_statement: The worker makes a blocking payment call inside the message loop, so a slow provider slows the whole consumer. The payment client timeout of 10 seconds let each slow call hold a worker for too long.
immediate_resolution: Payment client timeout lowered to 3 s and failed payments sent to the retry topic. Config change rolled out to orders-worker.

timeline.event: payment-gateway p95 latency rose from 300 ms to 4 s. None. There was no alert on payment latency.
Alert OrderQueueConsumerLagHigh fired with lag at 11,000. On-call followed SOP-QUEUE-002.
Workers scaled from 2 to 4. Lag growth slowed but did not stop. Read the worker logs and found slow payment calls.
timeline.action: Scaled workers from 2 to 4. Read the worker logs.

timeline.event: The payment provider confirmed a problem on their side. Paged the payments team on-call.
Payment client timeout lowered to 3 s and failed payments sent to the retry topic. Config change rolled out to orders-worker.
timeline.action: Lowered payment client timeout to 3 s and sent failed payments to the retry topic. Rolled out config change to orders-worker.

timeline.event: Lag back under 1,000. Closed the incident.
